---
title: Automatically route queries to continuous aggregates
description: Have TimescaleDB transparently route matching queries to a continuous aggregate instead of the raw hypertable
products: [cloud, self_hosted]
---

import * as C from "@constants";
import SinceRelease from "@components/SinceRelease.astro";
import Experimental from "../../../../partials/_experimental.mdx";
import TestPlan from "@components/TestPlan.astro";

<SinceRelease version="2.27.0" product="tsdb" />

<Experimental />

When you enable `timescaledb.enable_cagg_rewrites`, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} can transparently rewrite a query against a {C.HYPERTABLE} to read from a matching {C.CAGG} instead. If a {C.CAGG} aggregates exactly the columns and time buckets the query asks for, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} replaces the {C.HYPERTABLE} scan with a {C.CAGG} scan, which is much faster on large datasets.

## How {C.CAGG} query rewrites work

When you query a {C.HYPERTABLE} with `SELECT … GROUP BY time_bucket(…)`, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} looks for a {C.CAGG} on that {C.HYPERTABLE} whose definition matches the query's grouping columns, `time_bucket` width, and aggregates. If one matches, the planner replaces the {C.HYPERTABLE} scan with a scan of the {C.CAGG}'s materialization — the rewrite is invisible to the application.

The match must be exact. {C.TIMESCALE_DB} does not reaggregate (for example, it does not roll up 1-hour {C.CAGG} buckets into 2-hour query buckets).

## Use {C.CAGG} query rewrites

Turn the rewriting on:

```sql
SET timescaledb.enable_cagg_rewrites = on;
```

A second setting controls diagnostics:

```sql
SET timescaledb.cagg_rewrites_debug_info = on;
```

With `cagg_rewrites_debug_info` on, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} prints whether each query is eligible for rewriting and, if not, why. Set this on while `enable_cagg_rewrites` is off to inspect which queries would be rewritten without changing plans.

## Limitations

- **Exact match required.** The query must aggregate the same columns with the same `time_bucket` width as the target {C.CAGG}. {C.TIMESCALE_DB} does not roll up smaller buckets into larger ones to match a query.
- **Real-time {C.CAGG}s only.** A {C.CAGG} with the default `timescaledb.materialized_only = true` is not eligible. Set `materialized_only = false` on the {C.CAGG} you want the rewriter to use.
- **{C.PG} 16 or later.** Rewrites are not supported on {C.PG} 15.

<TestPlan>
target: cloud, self-hosted

1. fork the service
2. [cloud] select the service
3. [self-hosted] run SQL: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;`
4. expect rows: `SELECT 1 WHERE current_setting('server_version_num')::integer >= 160000`
5. run SQL: `CREATE TABLE conditions (time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, location TEXT, temperature DOUBLE PRECISION) WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = 'time');`
6. run SQL: `INSERT INTO conditions SELECT now() - INTERVAL '3 days' + i * INTERVAL '10 minutes', (ARRAY['office', 'lab'])[1 + i % 2], 20 + i % 7 FROM generate_series(1, 400) AS i;`
7. run SQL: `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_hourly WITH (timescaledb.continuous, timescaledb.materialized_only = false) AS SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS bucket, location, avg(temperature) AS avg_temperature FROM conditions GROUP BY bucket, location WITH NO DATA;`
8. run SQL: `CALL refresh_continuous_aggregate('conditions_hourly', NULL, NULL);`
9. run SQL:
    CREATE FUNCTION plan_lines(query TEXT, rewrites BOOLEAN) RETURNS SETOF TEXT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $plan_lines$
    DECLARE line RECORD;
    BEGIN
      PERFORM set_config('timescaledb.enable_cagg_rewrites', CASE WHEN rewrites THEN 'on' ELSE 'off' END, true);
      FOR line IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || query LOOP
        RETURN NEXT line."QUERY PLAN";
      END LOOP;
    END;
    $plan_lines$;
10. run SQL: `SET timescaledb.enable_cagg_rewrites = on;`
11. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM plan_lines($q$SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS bucket, location, avg(temperature) FROM conditions GROUP BY bucket, location$q$, true) AS line WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks AS c JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS ca ON c.hypertable_name = ca.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE ca.view_name = 'conditions_hourly' AND line LIKE '%' || c.chunk_name || '%')`
12. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM plan_lines($q$SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS bucket, location, avg(temperature) FROM conditions GROUP BY bucket, location$q$, false) AS line WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks AS c JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS ca ON c.hypertable_name = ca.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE ca.view_name = 'conditions_hourly' AND line LIKE '%' || c.chunk_name || '%')`
13. run SQL: `SET timescaledb.cagg_rewrites_debug_info = on;`
14. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM plan_lines($q$SELECT time_bucket('2 hours', time) AS bucket, location, avg(temperature) FROM conditions GROUP BY bucket, location$q$, true) AS line WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks AS c JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS ca ON c.hypertable_name = ca.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE ca.view_name = 'conditions_hourly' AND line LIKE '%' || c.chunk_name || '%')`
15. run SQL: `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_hourly SET (timescaledb.materialized_only = true);`
16. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM plan_lines($q$SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS bucket, location, avg(temperature) FROM conditions GROUP BY bucket, location$q$, true) AS line WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks AS c JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS ca ON c.hypertable_name = ca.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE ca.view_name = 'conditions_hourly' AND line LIKE '%' || c.chunk_name || '%')`
</TestPlan>
